title: Mama Max's Diner - Creamed Corn Recipe - Soul Food Cooking
description:
Maxine demonstrates her soul food cooking prowess with this from-scratch creamed corn recipe at her restaurant in Prescott, AR. Visit Mama Max's Diner Wednesday through Sunday at 1102 W Main St in Prescott, AR and try her creamed corn recipe and other great soul food cooking!

To learn more about restaurants in Arkansas, visit http://www.arkansas.com/dining/
author: Arkansas — The Natural State
